sentences.text: Alethodontus was an extinct genus of holocephalan cartilaginous fish, a member of the class Chondrichthyes.
This genus is known from a single species, A. bavariensis, which was found in Germany.
The genus Alethodontus was described by Duffin in 1983.
Alethodontus belongs to the parent group Myriacanthidae and is classified within the family Myriacanthidae.
Alethodontus lived between 201.4 and 199.5 million years ago during the Hettangian stage of the Jurassic period.
